name: A Street with Character
jem_summary: Reach at least 50 confirmed comfort in your occupied town.

pages.title: A Street with Character
pages.text: Reach at least 50 confirmed comfort in your occupied town.

pages.title: A Street with Character
pages.text: Lighting and greenery supplies help improve the street's remaining weak spots.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Connect actual homes with paths, light used streets and add greenery and peaceful animals. Empty purchased land is not comfort; sunlight is not street lighting. The interface identifies missing factors.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Comfort comes from used paths, animals, lighting and greenery; expensive blocks do not automatically score more.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Guards must actually belong to and defend the town; a personal escort away with its player is not local security.

pages.title: Town management
pages.text: With Recruits installed, hire your own through its native screen and enroll it in your territory; server checks ownership/payroll. A guard contributes only while actually defending the town. Native owner keeps management and outstanding payroll obligations.
